graph: import asyncio; from apps.vendor_dd.graphs import build_chat_graph, build_dimension_graph, build_main_graph; from zeroth.runtime.graph_validation import GraphValidator; validator=GraphValidator(); [asyncio.run(validator.validate_or_raise(build())) for build in (build_main_graph, build_dimension_graph, build_chat_graph)]
service-config: from apps.vendor_dd.entrypoint import build_auth_config; from zeroth.platform.config import get_settings; settings=get_settings(); assert settings.database.backend == 'sqlite' and build_auth_config().api_keys
contracts: from apps.vendor_dd.contracts import CONTRACTS; assert len(CONTRACTS) == 17 and 'contract://vendor-dd/dossier' in CONTRACTS
migrations: import tempfile; from pathlib import Path; from zeroth.service.bootstrap import run_migrations; path=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'cert.db'; run_migrations(f'sqlite:///{path}'); assert path.is_file()
container-startup: import subprocess; names=('app-cert-packaged','app-cert-ephemeral'); states=[subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect','--format={{.State.Running}}',name],text=True).strip() for name in names]; assert states == ['true','true'], states
health: import subprocess; names=('app-cert-packaged','app-cert-ephemeral'); states=[subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect','--format={{.State.Health.Status}}',name],text=True).strip() for name in names]; assert states == ['healthy','healthy'], states
policies: from apps.vendor_dd.entrypoint import build_policy_guard; assert build_policy_guard() is not None
